headline: A 2011 executive order directing federal agencies to spend money more efficiently.
what_it_does: This order from President Obama deals with how federal agencies spend money. Based on its title, it directs agencies to find ways to cut waste and spend more efficiently. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, targets, and spending areas are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to look for ways to spend their budgets more efficiently.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 9, 2011; the effective date is not stated in the provided information.
